about: The tractus of the formulary “Third Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: To Thee have I lifted up my eyes, Who dwellest in the heavens. Behold, as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress, so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us. Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us.
